paragraphs: A traveler can cross the forest using different travel strategies. The journey planner keeps a strategy and asks it to plan the route.
Build the shared contract and connect a concrete walking strategy to the planner.
imageAlt: A forest map with alternative routes between a cabin and a destination
caption: One journey, interchangeable ways to travel.
task: Assign each member and connect the planner, strategy interface, and walking strategy.
concept: Strategy lets a context use interchangeable algorithms through one shared interface.
